## Elasticity vs. Scalability
### Elasticity: Mr. Fantastic
The ability to dynamically and continuously absorb workload on demand. Like a rubber band reacting to being stretched by applied forces.

### Scalability
The changing in size or multiplying to handle capacity.
- Vertical Scaling is increasing in size or power: Ant-man growing bigger and therefore increasing strength and power
- Horizontal scaling is increasing in numbers like multi-man.

### High Availability (Redundancy)
Service is always online and accessible even when underlying hardware fails. Or at the very least, little to no downtime. 

### Agility
The ability to adapt with speed and flexibility.
- rapid develop, testing, launch of applications
- No waiting for buying and setting up hardware.
